openings.claim: Direct adjudication with conservative decision bounds rather than provisional aggregate gains. Script/spreadsheet per-record candidate-minus-baseline correctness contributions yield total and slice bounds: equal predictions contribute zero; unadjudicated flagged rows with differing predictions contribute conservatively between minus one and plus one; adjudications fix contributions. Permit advance/reject only when every remaining label assignment supports it.
openings.discriminator: Against the nearest rival, fixed slice-stratified sixteen-row review using corrected point totals, bounds should prevent unsupported threshold decisions reversible by residual uncertainty. They need not resolve more decisions or use fewer adjudications. Defeat requires demonstrated unsupported rival decisions or comparable certainty at greater rival cost; both unresolved establishes no advantage.
openings.probe: Use only supplied records/labels. Run matched copies with independently reset sixteen-row allowances and identical four preselected withheld rows. Access one selected sealed row at a time. Select accessible rows whose possible contributions can change total threshold four or slice threshold minus two; break ties by record ID. Advance if total lower bound is at least four and every slice lower bound at least minus two. Reject if total upper bound is below four or any slice upper bound below minus two. Otherwise continue within sixteen successful adjudications and seventy minutes, then report unresolved, affected slices and remaining bounds. Log selected IDs, reasons, responses, unavailable attempts, allowance use and elapsed time; unavailable attempts consume no allowance. Freeze both reports before opening full-label key; compare decisions, residual uncertainty, adjudications and time.
openings.uncertainty: Unflagged supplied labels remain fixed; disputed unflagged labels prevent bounds certifying a decision. Local script/spreadsheet must implement and verify conservative bounds within seventy minutes, otherwise unresolved. Withheld or numerous pivotal rows may prevent resolution.

lineage.reason: Preserves causal bounds, selection, complete rival/test conditions, declared fit, limits and uncertainties.

decision: Retain D1 as a bounded review probe for unchanged acceptance thresholds, not deployment evidence. Apparent improvement remains provisional until supported; annotator disagreement alone does not establish label error.
